Notes

Dear Giles Hugo,

Here’s the notes from your call with - Purchasing 0161 938 8080 on 25 September 2026 at 12:51:

This call involved Giles Hugo and Darren from Purchasing discussing the progress and delivery timeline of a set of drawings, with Darren confirming he will send the completed drawings by the end of the day for delivery within 10 days.

Recap

  • Darren from Purchasing is working on a set of drawings, having completed stainless steel parts and now working on carbon steel parts, aiming to send them by the end of the day.
  • Giles Hugo inquired about the delivery timeframe, and Darren confirmed a feasible delivery within 10 days due to the need for drilling, tapping, and folding processes.
  • They discussed the working hours, noting the office closes around 3:30 to 4:00 PM, and Darren plans to dedicate the afternoon to completing the drawings.
  • Giles Hugo clarified that the initial drawing numbers (up to 1 003) are all stainless steel, but the list can change, especially lower down, as the project details evolve.
  • Darren assured Giles that he will send the drawings before the end of the day, so they are available for Monday morning, even if not exactly on time.

Tasks

  • Darren from Purchasing will complete and send the drawings to Giles Hugo by the end of the day.
  • Giles Hugo will review the received drawings once they arrive, likely on Monday morning.
